## Natural history notes

A large orb-weaving spider characterized by its black body with bright yellow markings, long banded legs, and large circular web often containing a thick zigzag pattern. In Florida, it is found in gardens, fields, forest edges, roadsides, yards, and other sunny areas with tall vegetation for web attachment. It feeds on grasshoppers, flies, bees, and other flying insects caught in its web, often resting in the center of the web during the day.
